{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash -x

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./run.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --nodes=1            -> -N 1
#   --ntasks-per-node=4  -> -n 4
#   --time=00:30:00      -> -t 30m
#   --output=run.out     -> -o output=run.out
# (stderr redirection is not set here; see note)
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 4 -t 30m -o output=run.out --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=batch not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the batch partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --error=run.err not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stderr will follow Flux defaults (often merged with stdout unless configured).

  export LD_PRELOAD=$EBROOTIMKL/mkl/lib/intel64/libmkl_def.so:$EBROOTIMKL/mkl/lib/intel64/libmkl_avx2.so:$EBROOTIMKL/mkl/lib/intel64/libmkl_core.so:$EBROOTIMKL/mkl/lib/intel64/libmkl_intel_lp64.so:$EBROOTIMKL/mkl/lib/intel64/libmkl_intel_thread.so:$EBROOTIMKL/lib/intel64/libiomp5.so

  export PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH:/p/project/ccstma/cstma000/pySDC

  # Slurm used: srun python ...
  flux run -n 4 python pySDC_with_PETSc.py 1

  touch ready
fi
"
}
